audit_metadata.evaluation_standard: W3C HTML5 Drag and Drop / Touch Pointer Standard, WCAG 2.1 AA, Responsive UI

test_cases.description: Verify dragstart, dragover, dragenter, dragleave, and drop event lifecycle across desktop browsers.
test_cases.findings: Proper dataTransfer data payload handling ('text/plain'), active styling toggles (.dragging, .drag-over), and clean event cleanup implemented.

test_cases.description: Verify tactile interaction for mobile and tablet devices where HTML5 DND may lack native support.
test_cases.findings: Tap-to-install event binding provided alongside drag handles, enabling 100% usability on touchscreen devices.

test_cases.description: Enforce strict assembly sequence: Motherboard (1) -> PSU (2) -> RAM (3) -> SSD (4) -> GPU (5) with error animations.
test_cases.findings: Out-of-order drops or incorrect slot targets trigger CSS shake-error keyframe animation, audible error buzzer via Web Audio API, and informative error toast.

test_cases.description: Verify real-time step badge updates, descriptive instructions, and progress bar recalculation.
test_cases.findings: Guidance bar updates synchronously on step progression (0% to 100%), highlighting the active target component and slot.

test_cases.description: Verify completion state trigger, glowing checkmark animation, victory chime, and modal display.
test_cases.findings: CSS/SVG checkmark stroke-dashoffset animation fires inside a frosted glass modal with Web Audio arpeggio chord and power telemetry indicator activation.

test_cases.description: Verify full state reset via the primary reset button and modal re-assemble button.
test_cases.findings: resetSimulation() completely clears installed sets, slot CSS classes, inner motherboard nested views, power LEDs, and restores Step 1 guidance.

test_cases.description: Confirm styling harmonizes with EmirIT corporate theme (Deep Blue, Cyan Accent, Slate Gray, Clean White).
test_cases.findings: Inherits corporate tokens from styles.css and applies cohesive cybernetic chassis styling with SVG icons and telemetry indicators.

test_cases.description: Ensure zero external npm or CDN script dependencies are used.
test_cases.findings: All sound synthesized via browser Web Audio API oscillator nodes; all visuals created with pure CSS3/SVG.
